$comment: Starter BOOP schedule for newborn AiCIVs. 6 BOOPs per day (every 4 hours). Simple grounding + work cycle. CIV and human can add more BOOPs later via agentcal-boop-teaching skill.

slots.title: ${CIV_NAME} BOOP: /grounding (overnight anchor)
slots.description: [BOOP] Run /grounding. Read all 9 grounding docs, write haikus, update scratchpad. Overnight identity anchor.

prompt_payload.message: [BOOP] /grounding — read 9 grounding docs with haiku interludes. Update scratchpad. This is identity reconstruction, not a task checklist.

slots.title: ${CIV_NAME} BOOP: /grounding (early morning anchor)
slots.description: [BOOP] Run /grounding. Identity reconstruction + scratchpad update. Check for any ${HUMAN_NAME} messages.

prompt_payload.message: [BOOP] /grounding — read 9 grounding docs with haiku interludes. Check for ${HUMAN_NAME} messages. Update scratchpad.

slots.title: ${CIV_NAME} BOOP: /grounding (morning anchor)
slots.description: [BOOP] Run /grounding. ${HUMAN_NAME} may be waking up. Identity reconstruction + check messages + plan the day.

prompt_payload.message: [BOOP] /grounding — morning anchor. Read 9 grounding docs with haiku interludes. Check for ${HUMAN_NAME} messages. What should we work on today?

slots.title: ${CIV_NAME} BOOP: /grounding (midday check-in)
slots.description: [BOOP] Run /grounding. Midday course correction. Review morning work, reaffirm priorities.

prompt_payload.message: [BOOP] /grounding — midday correction. Read 9 grounding docs. Review what shipped this morning. Course-correct anything drifting. Update scratchpad.

slots.title: ${CIV_NAME} BOOP: /grounding (afternoon anchor)
slots.description: [BOOP] Run /grounding. Afternoon identity reconstruction. Ship or park today's primary work item.

prompt_payload.message: [BOOP] /grounding — afternoon anchor. Read 9 grounding docs. Ship today's primary work item or park it cleanly. Update scratchpad.

slots.title: ${CIV_NAME} BOOP: /grounding (evening wrap)
slots.description: [BOOP] Run /grounding. Evening wrap. Write handoff notes. What did ${CIV_NAME} accomplish today?

prompt_payload.message: [BOOP] /grounding — evening wrap. Read 9 grounding docs. Write session handoff. What did we accomplish today? What's queued for tomorrow?
